title: Kowloon City in 1998: the shop signs under the flight path
dek: Period shop signs, rooftop aerials and scaffolding, and a jet passing just overhead.
description: The Kowloon City street scene in Fly Kai Tak: shop signs from period photos, rooftop aerials, bamboo scaffolding and a jet passing just overhead.
hero_alt: A 747 passing low over Kowloon City shop signs, seen from a street.
hero_caption: A 747 passing low over Kowloon City shop signs.
card_sub: Shop signs under the flight path
